story: Stage 1 of the Paris–Nice began with a six-rider breakaway that gained a maximum advantage of around 1:40. The peloton kept the move under control with Team Picnic PostNL and NSN Cycling Team doing most of the work on the front. In the final kilometres the GC teams moved forward to take over the pacing, increasing the tempo of the bunch. The breakaway was eventually caught with 1.5 km remaining. In the bunch sprint, Marijn van den Berg delivered the decisive lead-out for Luke Lamperti, who powered to the stage victory.
